name: Falling Into Temptation
overview: Scripture reveals that temptation is a real and present challenge, as Jesus Himself was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil (Matthew 4:1). Believers are called to watch and pray to avoid falling into temptation, recognizing the weakness of the flesh despite the willingness of the spirit (Matthew 26:41). Loving Christ is demonstrated through obedience to His commandments (John 14:15), and believers are urged to clothe themselves with Jesus and resist fulfilling the desires of the flesh (Romans 13:14). Ultimately, God’s protection and deliverance from evil come as we diligently obey His statutes and seek His guidance (Exodus 15:26; Matthew 6:13).
